name: ubuntu
description: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble). Intaked once. Runs anywhere Phoenix runs. No installer. No wizard. Phoenix brings the OS.
author: Canonical / Phoenix intake by jwl247

metadata.login_note: Cloud-init seed (tools/poc/ubuntu-seed/) creates a sudo-capable 'phoenix' user (password 'phoenix'). SSH: ssh -p 2222 phoenix@127.0.0.1 once booted. Image format is raw (.img) — usys run handles this automatically.
metadata.shared_fs_note: Pass --share to 'usys run ubuntu' to enable. Same mount tags as Debian — both distros share the same F:\Phoenix\ tree. security_model=mapped-xattr — no elevation required.
